regisSubTitle: According to Section 24 of the Political Party Act of 2017, in applying for party membership, applicants must "have" the following qualifications and "not have" the following prohibited characteristics:
feature1: Having Thai nationality by birth or by naturalization and having held Thai nationality for not less than 5 years.
feature2: Be at least 18 years of age on the date of application for membership.
prohibitedItems2: Is a bankrupt or has been a fraudulent bankrupt.
prohibitedItems3: Be a monk, novice, ascetic or priest.
prohibitedItems4: Voting rights are being revoked regardless of whether the case has reached a final decision or not.
prohibitedItems6: Temporarily suspended from the right to run for election or has had the right to run for election revoked.
prohibitedItems7: Sentenced to imprisonment and detained by court order.
prohibitedItems8: Have been sentenced to prison and released from prison less than 10 years prior to the date of application for membership, except for negligence or minor offenses.
prohibitedItems9: Have you ever been ordered to leave a government agency, state agency, or state enterprise due to corruption or considered to have committed corruption or misconduct in the government sector.
prohibitedItems10: Have you ever been sentenced by a final court judgment or order that your assets be confiscated by the state due to unusual wealth or have you ever been sentenced by a final court judgment to imprisonment for committing an offense under the Anti-Corruption Act.
prohibitedItems11: Have been convicted of an offense against their official duties or their duties in the justice system, or an offense under the law on offenses against government officials or agencies, or an offense against property committed through corruption according to the Criminal Code, an offense under the law on fraudulent loans to the public, the law on narcotics, an offense as a manufacturer, importer, exporter, or dealer, the law on gambling, an offense as a bookmaker or a dealer, the law on prevention and suppression of human trafficking, or the law on prevention and suppression of money laundering, an offense of money laundering.
prohibitedItems12: Has been convicted of committing election fraud.
prohibitedItems13: Being a senator or having been a senator and the membership has ended within 2 years.
prohibitedItems14: Being a judge of the Constitutional Court or holding a position in an independent organization.
prohibitedItems15: Under a prohibition against holding political positions.
prohibitedItems16: Has been removed from office because the Constitutional Court ruled that there was a proposal for an amendment or any action that resulted in MPs, Senators or committee members having a direct or indirect involvement in the use of the budget.
prohibitedItems17: Has been removed from office because the Supreme Court or the Supreme Court's Criminal Division for Holders of Political Positions has ruled that the person has unusual wealth or has committed an offense of corruption or has intentionally performed duties or exercised power contrary to the provisions of the Constitution or the law or has seriously violated or failed to comply with ethical standards.
prohibitedItems18: Being banned from holding any position in a political party according to the Political Party Act.
prohibitedItems19: Not being a member of another political party or a person applying for registration of a political party or a person notifying preparations for the establishment of another political party on the date of applying for party membership.
